extraction.line_filter: enabled and closed; both endpoints MV; nonswitch; positive length; explicit OpenDSS units
extraction.topology: simple undirected graph merges phase-parallel edges; include MV switches and MV transformers; largest component BFS from nearest source; leaf and degree-two buses retained
extraction.demand: enabled positive snapshot model kW, boundary Aggregate loads excluded, LV customers summed at nearest MV bus without crossing HV; positive sites normalized by each feeder mean
extraction.unknown_length_policy: excluded from physical length distribution, zero placeholder in topology-only M1 template
